spec.data_source: Read-only individually retrieved Google Directory login metadata or scoped IAM federation pool/provider inventories with exact source receipts.
spec.predicate: The individual user has a recorded login within 90 days, or the user was created within that interval. The enabled individual Directory user has a valid last recorded login older than 90 days, within the current user lifetime. Missing or denied evidence remains unresolved.
spec.title: Enabled directory user has a recent recorded login
spec.description: Reviews the latest recorded login on an individual enabled Google Directory user, using the immutable user ID rather than the potentially inaccurate users-list login field. The current project-to-organization-to-directory-customer chain, individual metadata request, user ID, email, creation time and account state must match. Missing, sentinel or contradictory dates remain unresolved.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm ownership and dependencies before disabling an inactive user or deleting an obsolete federation pool.

description.description: Reviews the latest recorded login on an individual enabled Google Directory user, using the immutable user ID rather than the potentially inaccurate users-list login field. The current project-to-organization-to-directory-customer chain, individual metadata request, user ID, email, creation time and account state must match. evaluated: current Directory user ID, email, customer, suspended and archived state
independent CRM project and ancestor GET chain to directoryCustomerId
individual Directory users.get metadata projection and source request
creationTime and lastLoginTime with a 90-day recorded-login threshold
description.pass_when: The individual user has a recorded login within 90 days, or the user was created within that interval.
description.fail_when: The enabled individual Directory user has a valid last recorded login older than 90 days, within the current user lifetime.
description.not_applicable_when: Suspended or archived accounts are not active unused-account candidates.

requirements.reason: Bounded human-identity review signal: an individual Directory user GET reports an old login for a currently enabled account, with exact current UID and directory-customer binding. This is not complete workload/API activity, password-use evidence, organizational necessity or deactivation.

spec.data_source: Read-only individually retrieved Google Directory login metadata or scoped IAM federation pool/provider inventories with exact source receipts.
spec.predicate: At least one current ACTIVE provider is enabled for the pool. An active federation-only pool has no enabled provider in a complete current provider list. Missing or denied evidence remains unresolved.
spec.title: Active workload identity pool has an enabled federation provider
spec.description: Identifies active federation-only workload identity pools without an enabled provider after complete current provider enumeration. Pool project identity, native IAM list authority, provider parent, ACTIVE/deleted state and disabled flags are checked. Trust-domain pools are excluded because they use managed workload identities and cannot have external federation providers. Provider presence is structural evidence, not token-use history.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm ownership and dependencies before disabling an inactive user or deleting an obsolete federation pool.

evaluated: current selected-project workload pool name and exact project ID/number binding
unfiltered complete IAM pool and provider lists and source receipts
pool mode: federation-only versus managed workload trust domain
description.pass_when: At least one current ACTIVE provider is enabled for the pool.
description.fail_when: An active federation-only pool has no enabled provider in a complete current provider list.
description.not_applicable_when: Disabled or deleted pools and managed-workload trust-domain pools are outside this external-provider predicate.

requirements.reason: Bounded federation identity lifecycle signal: a currently active external-federation pool lacks any enabled provider after complete scoped enumeration. This supports obsolete identity-configuration review; it does not establish prior token use, organizational necessity or deactivation.

spec.description: Identifies active workforce identity pools without an enabled provider after complete current provider enumeration. The workforce pool parent must match the selected organization, and IAM list receipts must retain that organization parent and exact provider-list path. This identifies a structurally obsolete federation namespace without asserting that any token or IAM permission has never been used.
